extra_vocab.en: the time when a new product or service is first shown or sold to the public
extra_vocab.note: 句中的 the launch 指新產品或活動的正式推出日；delay the launch by a week 是「把上市日延後一週」，語氣是在會議上提出建議。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: launch 當名詞常用 the launch of + 產品（the launch of the new app）；delay ... by + 時間長度 的 by 表示延後「多久」。

example.en: The company plans two product launches in the second quarter.
example.zh: 公司計畫在第二季推出兩項新產品。

example.en: She launches the new marketing campaign for our team every spring.
example.zh: 她每年春天都會為我們團隊展開新的行銷活動。

example.en: We launched the new company website last Monday morning.
example.zh: 我們上週一早上推出了新的公司網站。

example.en: We are launching a mobile app next month.
example.zh: 我們下個月要推出一款手機應用程式。

example.en: The product launch attracted more than two hundred guests.
example.zh: 新產品發表會吸引了兩百多位賓客。

example.en: Has the launch date been confirmed by the marketing team?
example.zh: 行銷團隊確認上市日期了嗎？

example.en: We plan to launch a campaign to attract younger customers.
example.zh: 我們計畫展開活動來吸引年輕客戶。

example.en: Please register early for the launch event in Taipei.
example.zh: 請提早報名台北的發表活動。

examples.en: Several customers were waiting for the launch of the new model.
examples.zh: 有幾位客戶一直在等新機型上市。

examples.en: Please send me the final schedule for the launch by Friday.
examples.zh: 請在週五前把上市的最終時程寄給我。

examples.en: The company launched a new line of eco-friendly bags.
examples.zh: 公司推出了一系列新的環保袋。

examples.en: She quit her job to launch her own consulting business.
examples.zh: 她辭掉工作，創辦了自己的顧問公司。

confusable.diff: lunch 是午餐，拼法和字尾發音都和 launch 很像，但意思完全不同。

example.en: We will discuss the schedule over lunch tomorrow.
example.zh: 我們明天邊吃午餐邊討論時程。

similar.diff: release 常指新版本、新產品正式發佈；launch 強調正式推出並開始宣傳。

example.en: The software company will release the update next Monday.
example.zh: 這家軟體公司下週一會發佈更新。

similar.diff: introduce 指首次把新產品介紹給市場，語氣較平淡；launch 較有活動感。

example.en: We plan to introduce three new flavors this spring.
example.zh: 我們計畫今年春天推出三種新口味。

similar.diff: roll out 指逐步推出到各地區或各部門，不一定是第一次公開。

example.en: The bank will roll out the new app in stages.
example.zh: 銀行會分階段推出新的應用程式。

example.en: The new smartphone made its debut at the trade show.
example.zh: 新手機在展覽會上首次亮相。

example.en: The release of the new version is planned for May.
example.zh: 新版本預計在五月發佈。

example.en: The advertising campaign increased our sales by ten percent.
example.zh: 這次廣告活動讓我們的銷售額增加了百分之十。

derived.link: re- + launch，再一次推出，像 rebuild、renew 的 re- 是「再次」

example.en: The launch of the new product was a big success.
example.zh: 新產品的上市非常成功。

example.en: We plan to launch the new service in March.
example.zh: 我們計畫三月推出新的服務。

senses.en: the first time a new product or service is offered to the public

example.en: Sales were strong right after the launch of the new phone.
example.zh: 新手機上市後，銷售立刻很強勁。

senses.en: to start an important activity or plan
senses.distinguish: 受詞是調查、活動、計畫等，而不是實體產品時用這個意思。

example.en: The company launched an investigation into the data problem.
example.zh: 公司針對這個資料問題展開了調查。

extra_vocab.en: even though something makes it difficult or unlikely
extra_vocab.note: 句中的 despite higher costs 表示儘管成本上升，價格仍然維持低，帶有轉折與強調努力的語氣，後面直接接名詞。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: despite 後面接名詞或 V-ing，不接完整子句，也不加 of（✗ despite of）；要接子句時用 although，或 despite the fact that + 子句。

example.en: Despite the fact that sales dropped, we kept all our staff.
example.zh: 儘管銷售下滑，我們仍留下了所有員工。

example.en: Despite the delay, the shipment arrived before the deadline.
example.zh: 儘管有延誤，貨物仍在期限前送達。

example.en: The sales event was a success despite the weather.
example.zh: 儘管天氣不好，這場促銷活動仍很成功。

examples.en: Despite the budget cut, the team finished the project on time.
examples.zh: 儘管預算被刪減，團隊仍準時完成了專案。

examples.en: Thank you for your help despite your busy schedule.
examples.zh: 謝謝您在行程繁忙的情況下仍幫忙。

examples.en: He still attended the conference despite feeling very sick.
examples.zh: 儘管很不舒服，他仍參加了研討會。

examples.en: Sales rose by ten percent despite higher prices.
examples.zh: 儘管價格較高，銷售額仍成長了百分之十。

confusable.diff: although 意思和 despite 接近，但 although 是連接詞，後面要接完整子句。
confusable.usage: despite + 名詞／V-ing；although + 主詞 + 動詞。

example.en: Although prices are higher, customers keep buying our products.
example.zh: 儘管價格較高，客戶仍持續購買我們的產品。

similar.diff: in spite of 意思完全相同，字數較多、語氣稍口語；despite 較簡短，書面常用。

example.en: In spite of the heavy rain, the meeting started on time.
example.zh: 儘管下大雨，會議仍準時開始。

similar.diff: regardless of 表示「不管、不受…影響」，強調沒有差別；despite 強調有困難仍做到。

example.en: All employees receive training regardless of their job titles.
example.zh: 不論職稱為何，所有員工都會接受訓練。

example.en: The price is high, though the quality is excellent.
example.zh: 價格雖高，但品質極佳。

example.en: We offered a discount. However, the customer refused the deal.
example.zh: 我們提供了折扣，然而客戶拒絕了這筆交易。

example.en: The plan looks simple, yet it takes a lot of time.
example.zh: 這個計畫看起來簡單，卻很花時間。
